title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Good work, Doctor. Why don't you take a break? Oh, don't worry, I'm already done with the report… Haha, there's no need for a compliment. It's really not a big deal, I've simply become experienced with these things.

title: Talk 1
original: Wait, wait, Doctor, s-stop tugging, I'll take them out myself! There, all the cards I hid up my sleeves. Haha, I figured you'd see right through me. If we get a chance to go to Dossoles, I'll show you some even more interesting things.

title: Talk 2
original: Every time I talk to Miss Ch'en, as well as that Miss Lin, I get all nervous. Man, I really don't want to get beaten up again… What, you can't tell? Well, Doctor, here, check out my palms. They're all sweaty!

title: Talk 3
original: Yo, Doctor, fancy seeing you here. Looking for someone? Oh, Rafaela? I'm afraid I don't know where she is either. Guess you can tell, without the old man here, we have very little to say to each other.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: My old man threw me into the army reserves when I was just a kid. We were all kids, really. Some of us had burning ambitions, but I'd say most of us didn't even know what we wanted. Life was tough, and we were just looking for a way out, nothing more.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Dossoles should be in good hands with Miss Candela. As for the old man, he's better off behind bars for now. He needs to calm down and reflect on his actions. You see, Doctor, when I agreed to help him one last time,  it was my way of trying to find answers,  and sort out my thoughts. Now... I've found my answers.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: When we first arrived in Dossoles, Rafaela and I were still very young. We quickly adapted to life there, but the old man still insisted on his integrity and his old ideology... Can't do anything about it, but I figure I should at least try to help.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Doctor, here's the mission report from last time. I've already handled the follow-ups. Ah, don't worry, there won't be any problems. It'd be a real bummer if something unexpected happened and ruined our carefully laid plans. I'm not about to allow that.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: So how about it, Doctor? Did you draw the card you wanted? Aw, better luck next time! Though I should say, in a game of chance, there's nothing less reliable than luck. But rest assured, if you're ever in need of it, I'll deliver luck right into your hands.

title: Idle
original: Doctor, I'll put all the materials I've organized over here. Hm? Asleep… Look at all the important documents you left lying here... You must trust me a whole lot…

title: Onboard
original: Hello there, are you the Doctor? Great, you're just as recognizable as Miss Ch'en said you'd be. Oh, right, I should pick out a code name, then? Hmm... Let's go with Tequila! Sounds pretty nice, eh?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I'm supposed to try this move myself? That… seems painful.

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? Already? Whoa… thanks a million. In any case, without further ado, let's talk about future changes to my work…

title: Promotion 2
original: When Miss Ch'en brought me in, I never thought I'd see a day like this. So, does that mean I'm one of your most capable subordinates? Haha, it's not a joke, whether you need me to be a tour guide or something else, you can rest easy knowing you're in good hands.

title: Added to Squad
original: OK, Got it. Leave it to me.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I'm in charge of the squad? Haha, I appreciate the trust…

title: Depart
original: Follow my lead. Be careful, and don't fall behind.

title: Begin Operation
original: Come, let us show our guests some hospitality.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Need my help with anything?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Awaiting orders.

title: Deployment 1
original: Sorry, this path is closed for business.

title: Deployment 2
original: Pardon me, I'd like you all to stop right there.

title: In Battle 1
original: Don't get worked up, let's talk first.

title: In Battle 2
original: Violence isn't really my thing, but well…

title: In Battle 3
original: Negotiation Failed.

title: In Battle 4
original: Begone.

title: 4-star Result
original: You even managed to anticipate their ambush, Doctor! I guess there's no shame in them losing like that. I still have much to learn.

title: 3-star Result
original: Everything's taken care of, Doctor... How did I take care of it? Doctor, do you really need to hear that?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Phew, that was a close one. Are you alright, Doctor? Yeah… A few of 'em got away. Let me see…

title: Operation Failure
original: Let's retreat for now! We'll live to fight another day!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Ah, so this is the dorm... Mind if I give it a makeover, and buy some little decorations for it?

title: Tap
original: Tsk... What the… Oh, it's you, Doctor.

title: Trust Tap
original: It was raining out there just now, and my hair got a little wet... Sorry, Doctor, could you pass me that towel?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy new year, Doctor! My new cards are here, so, how about a game? Entertainment at Rhodes Island is nothing compared to Dossoles, sure, but as long as you've got me, we'll manage. I know a thing or two about creating a festive atmosphere.

title: Greeting
original: How are you feeling today? Want to head out for a bit?

title: Birthday
original: Here, Doctor, a birthday present for you. Guess what's in the box… Hey, no, don't shake it so hard! It's expensive, and we'll have nothing to drink if you break it!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: For those who seek change but set off on the wrong foot, no matter how flashy their appearance, they will always lack substance. That's why I appreciate Rhodes Island and its work. Salud, Doctor, to us both finding the right path forward.
